# Mirc Glow

> Korean-inspired skincare brand from Bhatkal, Karnataka, India. Four creams and three sets built around avocado, glutathione and kojic acid; every cream also contains aloe vera and vitamin B3. Sold directly across India with free shipping, Cash on Delivery and 7-day returns on sealed jars. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+91 99808 81230).

Important: Mirc Glow creams are cosmetics. They help skin feel softer and look smoother and more even. They do not change natural skin tone and are not intended to treat skin conditions. They are Korean-inspired; manufacturing details are printed on each pack.

## Products (prices in INR, October 2026)
- [Avocado Korean Night Cream (25 g)](https://mircglow.com/product/avocado-korean-night-cream/): ₹649 (MRP ₹899). Our Korean-inspired avocado night cream in a 25 g jar, with aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. Best for: Most skin types; a softer, more even-looking complexion. Use: Evening, as the last step.

- [Avocado Night Cream (30 g)](https://mircglow.com/product/avocado-night-cream/): ₹649 (MRP ₹949). A rich avocado night cream with aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. Korean-inspired care for skin that feels soft and comfortable by morning. Best for: Dry or tight-feeling skin; the best value per gram. Use: Evening, as the last step.
- [Avocado Glow Cream (10 g)](https://mircglow.com/product/avocado-face-cream/): ₹349 (MRP ₹449). A light daily avocado cream with aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid, in a 10 g jar. Best for: First-time buyers, travel, and daytime under sunscreen. Use: Morning under sunscreen, or at night.
- [Day & Night Combo (10 g + 30 g)](https://mircglow.com/product/day-and-night-cream-combo/): ₹849 (MRP ₹998). Two avocado creams: the light Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream for the morning and the rich Avocado Night Cream with Kojic Acid for the evening. Best for: A complete, simple moisturising routine. Use: Day cream in the morning, night cream in the evening.
- [Night Cream Combo (30 g + 30 g)](https://mircglow.com/product/night-cream-combo/): ₹1799 (MRP ₹2148). Our Glutathione Cream with vitamin C and kojic acid, paired with the rich Avocado Night Cream. Radiance-focused care and deep nourishment for your evenings. Best for: Radiance and deep nourishment in one evening routine. Use: Alternate nights at first, then layer.

Three Korean-inspired creams: the Glutathione Cream for radiance, the Avocado Korean Night Cream for nourishment, and the Avocado Glow cream for the day. Best for: Beginners who want the full morning and night routine. Use: Day cream in the morning; night creams in the evening.

## Buying and policies
- [How to order](https://mircglow.com/shop/): tap Order on a product, send the prefilled WhatsApp message with your address; pay by Cash on Delivery or an online link.
- [Shipping policy](https://mircglow.com/shipping-policy/): free shipping across India, usually 3 to 7 days.
- [Returns and refunds](https://mircglow.com/returns-refunds/): unopened sealed jars within 7 days of delivery; damaged, wrong or expired items replaced or refunded.
- [Track your order](https://mircglow.com/track-order/)
- [Contact](https://mircglow.com/contact/): WhatsApp or phone +91 99808 81230; Azad Nagar 4th Cross, Bhatkal, Karnataka 581320.
- [Bulk night cream in kg](https://mircglow.com/bulk-night-cream/): wholesale supply for salons, resellers and brands.
